subject: Request: extra prep slot + data access before Atlas Health pilot demo
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra prep slot + data access before Atlas Health pilot demo

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for agreeing to a pilot with Redwood. I pulled together a suggested plan for the demo so we can properly validate performance on Atlas Health workloads:

- Proposed demo: Thu, Sep 2, 2026, 11:00 AM PT (live walkthrough + Q&A, ~45 min)
- Prep/dry-run window: Tue, Sep 7, 2026, 10:00 AM PT — internal dry run with your engineering lead and our SE to exercise sample prompts and workload traces
- What we need from you before the prep dry run: sanitized sample records (500–1,000 items), a short list of priority prompts (top 10), and credentials to a read-only test bucket or S3 path

I attached a short checklist for data formats and access (sample_data_requirements.pdf). If Sep 2 conflicts with travel or leadership bandwidth we can move the demo — the important thing is to leave us a 48–72 hour prep window after we receive the data so Sergio can run latency/cost traces and tune batching/kv-cache settings.

Can you confirm whether Sep 2 works, and whether procurement needs to be included for scheduling / contract coordination?

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

----
Attachment: sample_data_requirements.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@atlashealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra prep slot + data access before Atlas Health pilot demo

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the clear plan. Unfortunately the proposed Sep 2 demo conflicts with a quarterly leadership offsite — I (and our CTO) will be traveling that day. We could do the live demo the week after; Sep 9 or Sep 10 are likely good.

We also like the idea of a dry run. Can Redwood do a shorter internal prep/dry-run on Sep 8? We want your SE to validate the prompt set and run a couple of workload traces against a small sample. I've attached a tiny preview of the CSV we can share (sanitized) so you can see formatting (data_sample_preview.csv).

Procurement is CC'd and will handle contract redlines separately — they may ask to see a short SOW that outlines the pilot scope.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Data Products, Atlas Health
alyssa.chen@atlashealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4490

----
Attachment: data_sample_preview.csv (CSV, 8 KB)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra prep slot + data access before Atlas Health pilot demo

Great, thanks for the quick reply and for the CSV preview. Sep 10 works for the live demo on our side — shifting is fine. Proposed updated schedule:

- Dry-run / prep session (internal): Sep 8, 2026, 10:00 AM PT — goal is to exercise your top 10 prompts and run workload traces on the sample data
- Production-facing demo: Sep 10, 2026, 11:00 AM PT — live walkthrough, performance numbers, and instrumented Q&A

Sergio (cc'd) will lead the dry run and will need read-only access to the test bucket by Sep 6 to run traces and prepare batching/quantization suggestions. I attached a compact prep checklist we use to ensure plug-and-play (prep_checklist.md).

Sergio — can you confirm you'll be available Sep 8 at 10 AM PT and that the team has the right tooling (S3 credentials or secure file drop)?

Alyssa — if Procurement needs a pilot SOW, Marissa can provide a one-pager.

Thanks — I'll send calendar invites once we have confirmation.

Rachel

----
Attachment: prep_checklist.md (Markdown, 4 KB)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@atlashealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra prep slot + data access before Atlas Health pilot demo

Thanks, Rachel — that schedule looks good.

We will:
- Confirm Sep 8 dry-run and Sep 10 live demo on our calendars
- Provide sanitized 1,000-item sample and S3 read-only credentials by EOD Sep 6 (IT is looped in)
- Procurement will review the one-page SOW from Marissa — cc'd here is our procurement lead (procurement@atlashealth.com)

Sergio — we expect Alex (our platform engineer) to join the dry-run. I'll forward the sample and credentials to you once IT approves the transfer.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the dry-run so we can get reliable latency numbers for our stakeholder deck.

Best,
Alyssa
